outcome: Satisfaction with skilled delivery (overall and in six dimensions: communication, responsiveness, technical quality, dignity, autonomy, and financial)
Correlation between overall satisfaction and satisfaction in specific dimensions
cohort: 538 postpartum mothers in the Akatsi South District, Ghana
finding: While overall satisfaction with skilled delivery was high, satisfaction with the financial dimension was low, and several factors were associated with satisfaction in specific dimensions.
mod_finding: Postpartum mothers who had a cesarean section were more likely to be satisfied with the communication dimension of skilled delivery compared to those who had a vaginal delivery.
